item.title: Garbage Collection for Rust: The Finalizer Frontier
item.description:
📝 Unlike previous approaches to GC in Rust, Alloy allows existing Rust destructors to be automatically used as GC finalizers: this makes Alloy integrate better with existing Rust code than previous solutions but introduces surprising soundness and performance problems. Normal Rust code uses destructors (i. We show that it is possible to reuse most Rust destructors as finalizers in a satisfying way.
🔗 Read more: https://soft-dev.org/pubs/html/hughes_tratt__garbage_collection_for_rust_the_finalizer_frontier/
